name: us032-origin-trailing-dot
description: 032 C1.4: a designator whose host carries a DOUBLED trailing dot against a base with one. Exactly one trailing dot is insignificant, a second one is not. Before 032 the Bash port refused this (REF-HOST) while PowerShell matched it — a measured cross-port divergence in feature/seed, invisible to the corpus because no scenario exercised it. Locks the repair.
